entities.name: St. Anthony Cathedral, Huancavelica
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The St. Anthony Cathedral is the main Catholic church in Huancavelica, a city in the South American country of Peru. It was constructed between the 16th and 17th centuries and was initially built by the Tonsurados. The predominant architectural style is Churrigueresque Baroque.
